q1.explanationZh: 女孩说今天跟妈妈去买衣服，没看到喜欢的鞋子，但买了一条很酷的连衣裙（dress）。A 错：她本来需要鞋子，但没买到；B 错：毛衣是旧的。

q2.explanationZh: 女孩以为要下雨，男孩说会一直不下雨，但下午风会很大（really windy），所以可能踢不了足球。A 错：男孩说不会下雨；C 错：晴天是明天。

q3.explanationZh: 妈妈想住大酒店，爸爸不太高兴，所以他们订了一家带漂亮花园的家庭旅馆（guest house）。B 错：爸爸喜欢露营，但这次没有露营；C 错：大酒店只是妈妈的想法。

q4.explanationZh: 男孩说他做地理做烦了，就把历史练习全部做完了，数学也快做完了——做完的是历史。A 错：数学还差一点没做完；B 错：地理他只是开了个头。

q5.explanationZh: 女孩想去游泳，但游泳池整个周末都有比赛进不去，后来她和姐妹打了一场羽毛球，还赢了。B 错：去航海的是男孩；C 错：她没能去游泳。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说玻璃厂常做玻璃动物之类的东西，但这家工厂以碗（bowls）出名。玻璃动物是干扰项。

q7.explanationZh: 工厂广告上用的图画是一只海豚（dolphin），老师只是觉得它有点像一朵云。cloud 是干扰项。

q8.explanationZh: 大家要 8:30 到学校，因为大巴 8:45（eight forty-five）出发，所以离校时间是 8:45。8:30 是到校时间，9:45 是到达工厂的时间。

q9.explanationZh: 老师说不用带午饭，但请带上笔记本（notebooks），手机要留在家里。午饭和手机都是干扰项。

q10.explanationZh: 要联系的是新来的美术老师 Mr Stapely，老师把姓拼了出来：S-T-A-P-E-L-Y。

q11.explanationZh: Mark 说很高兴妈妈能开车送他们去，所以是坐汽车去的。A 错：Jessica 说公交车很慢；C 错：音乐节离火车站很远。

q12.explanationZh: Mark 说下次想带帐篷露营，Jessica 说她喜欢住在 Jim 叔叔的公寓，Mark 也说那里比酒店好——他们住在亲戚家。A 错：露营是下次的打算；B 错：他们没有住酒店。

q13.explanationZh: Mark 说音乐节比大多数音乐节便宜，天气也好，只是人太多了。B 错：他说比较便宜；C 错：他们说运气好，天气不错。

q14.explanationZh: Mark 说 Amelia 很漂亮（so pretty），Jessica 也说她很美（beautiful），两人都认为她看起来很棒。A 错：没人说她的歌很特别；C 错：Jessica 最喜欢她，但 Mark 最喜欢最后那支乐队。

q15.explanationZh: Mark 说他给妈妈买了巧克力、给自己买了一条围巾，Jessica 说“我也买了一条”——她买的是围巾，是穿戴的东西。A 错：巧克力是 Mark 给妈妈买的；B 错：两人都没买那本书。

q16.explanationZh: 女孩说这位来访者能经常旅行，会认识很多不同的人，还带他们参观有趣的地方——这是导游的工作。B 错：拉小提琴的是上一位演讲者；C 错：摄影师只是男孩举的例子。

q17.explanationZh: 女孩说故事讲的是一个少女骑摩托车穿越非洲的经历，是一次激动人心的旅程。A 错：封面上有狮子，书里也有很多动物，但不是讲一种特别的动物；B 错：她以后可能成为歌手，但现在还不是著名音乐家。

q18.explanationZh: 老师让 Frank 把书放回架子上，Milo 把笔放到讲台上，其他人把地上的纸屑扔进垃圾桶——她要学生整理教室。B 错：她说不许抄袭；C 错：收拾好后要坐下写作文，不是准备回家。

q19.explanationZh: 女孩说她看了网上的视频，用了里面的一些观点，还发现了一些她希望老师会喜欢的内容——她对找到的信息很满意。B 错：她写了半页，比男孩写得多，并不担心；C 错：她只是希望老师会喜欢，并不确定。

q20.explanationZh: 老师说这本书的作者是以前在这里教书的 Lam 老师，问大家觉得名字熟不熟——作者可能是学生认识的人。A 错：老师说书不属于任何学生；B 错：想读的话要让家长去买，不是全班一起读。

q21.explanationZh: Anna 说 Sophie 和她不一样，会把书放在书架上、衣服放进柜子里——Sophie 的卧室很整洁（tidy）。

q22.explanationZh: Anna 说 Leo 的房间空间很大（lots of space），但她觉得不太舒服——所以是大（big）。D 错：她说的是不舒服。

q23.explanationZh: Anna 说她们没在厨房待多久，因为里面不太暖和——厨房很冷（cold）。F 错：modern 是 Sophie 的妈妈想把厨房改得更现代。

q24.explanationZh: Anna 觉得客厅的椅子坐着很舒服，地毯也很软——客厅很舒适（comfortable）。E 错：暗的是她们旧房子的客厅，这个客厅不暗。

q25.explanationZh: Anna 说她从没见过那样的浴室，颜色很奇怪——浴室很特别（unusual）。A 错：beautiful 是例题中描述花园的词。

content.v: Test Four. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What did the girl buy today?
Nice sweater!
Thanks, Dad. Actually, it’s an old one. But I went shopping with Mum today, for some clothes.
Did you get anything nice? Didn’t you need some shoes?
I didn’t see any I liked, but I got this cool dress. I think I’ll wear it for Tanya’s barbecue party this afternoon.
Yeah. Maybe take a sweater, too – it’ll be cold later.
Two. What will the weather be like this afternoon?
I think it’s going to rain – look at the sky, there are lots of dark clouds.
It doesn’t look good at the moment but it’s going to stay dry.
Great. We can still play football this afternoon.
Well, it’s going to be really windy, so maybe not. But I’m sure it’ll be sunny again tomorrow.
I hope so.
Three. Where did the girl stay on her holiday?
How was your holiday?
Very good. You know Dad loves camping, but Mum wanted to stay in a big hotel this time. Dad wasn’t very happy about that, so we booked a guest house with a nice garden instead.
So, was it better than a tent?
It was actually. And the place only had two floors.
Well, I love camping.
Four. Which homework has the boy finished?
Hi, have you finished your homework?
I’ve done the maths – that was easy, and I’ve nearly finished science. What about you?
I started geography, but got bored, so did all the history exercise and I’ve almost finished the maths.
Shall we do our geography together at the library?
OK, I’ll bring my maths book too – we can check our answers.
Five. What did the girl do at the weekend?
Hi, did you have a good weekend?
Great, thanks. I wanted to go swimming, but there was a competition at the pool all weekend so I couldn’t go in.
So what did you do?
I won a game of badminton that I played with my sister! And you went sailing. I love that.
I’m going again next weekend – why don’t you come?
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling her students about a school trip to a glass factory.
Now listen everyone. The glass factory trip’s on June the twenty-first. That’s the same week as Sports Day, which is on the twenty-fifth.
Glass factories often make things like glass animals but this one is well-known for its bowls. I’ve got a lovely one for fruit.
You’ve probably seen the drawing which the factory uses for its adverts. It’s a dolphin. But actually, I think it looks a bit like a cloud.
You’ll need to be at school by eight thirty as the coach goes at eight forty-five. We hope to arrive at the factory around nine forty-five.
There’s no need to take lunch – we’ll have it there in the cafeteria, but please bring your notebooks and remember to leave your phones at home for the day. You can’t take them into the factory.
For more information contact the new art teacher, Mr Stapely, who’s planning everything. That’s spelled S-T-A-P-E-L-Y, if you want to find him on the school website.
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a brother and sister, Mark and Jessica, talking about a music festival they went to for the weekend.
The music festival was great, wasn’t it, Mark?
It really was, Jessica. I’m glad Mum could drive us there.
Yes, it was a long way from a railway station and buses are very slow.
Next time let’s take a tent and camp at the festival.
Really? I liked it at Uncle Jim’s flat.
You’re right. It was nice – and better than a hotel.
Did you enjoy everything at the festival? We were lucky with the weather.
I know. And it was cheaper than most festivals. It was just too crowded for me.
Oh? I enjoyed being with lots of people. What did you think of the singer called Amelia?
She was so pretty and I loved her songs. And she played the piano so well.
Yes, she was beautiful and sang well. I think I liked her best.
Oh I think that last band we saw was the best.
Did you buy that book about them at the festival shop?
No. But I got chocolates for Mum. And a scarf for me.
I got one of those too.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a visitor who gave a talk at their school. What is the visitor’s job?
What did you think of today’s speaker?
Fascinating. He has so many opportunities to travel. I’d love that.
There are lots of jobs where people can travel. Photographer, for example.
But he meets so many different people and shows them round really interesting places.
He had great stories, not like the last speaker, that guy who played the violin – really boring.
Seventeen. You will hear two friends talking about a book. What is the girl reading about?
I love the picture of the lion on the cover of your book.
It’s great! The story’s about a teenage girl who travelled across Africa on a motorbike. She saw lots of amazing animals.
I wouldn’t be brave enough to do that.
She says she’s written several songs about her trip. Perhaps she’ll be a well-known singer one day?
Eighteen. You will hear a teacher talking to her students. What does she want them to do?

OK everyone, it’s time to stop what you’re doing. Frank, could you collect the books and put them on the shelf near the coats. And Milo, those pens should be on my desk. Everyone else, if you notice any bits of paper on the floor, put them in the bin. Then sit down and start your essays. And no copying!
Nineteen. You will hear two friends talking about some homework. How does the girl feel about her homework?
Have you done that geography project that Mrs Williams gave us for homework?
Yes. I watched a video online and used some of the points they talked about.
Oh, I didn’t think of doing that.
Yeah, I found out some things that I’m hoping Mrs Williams will enjoy. I wrote about half a page.
That’s more than I did!
Twenty. You will hear a teacher talking to his class about a book. Why is he talking to his class about the book?

Can I have your attention, everyone? Look at this book. No, it doesn’t belong to any of you. See the name on the cover? Does it look familiar? Mrs Lam was a teacher here, remember? Well, now she’s an author. Isn’t that interesting? If you’d like to read her book, ask your parents if you can get it.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Anna talking to her mother about her friend Sophie’s house. What does Anna think of each place in Sophie’s house?
Hi, Anna. Did you have fun with Sophie? What’s her family’s new house like? Does it have a big garden?
The garden’s lovely, Mum, but it’s quite small. It’s got lots of pretty flowers.
What did you think of Sophie’s bedroom?
Well, Sophie’s different from me – she puts all her books on the shelves and her clothes in the cupboard.
Not like you at all! Did you see her brother Leo’s bedroom?
Yeah. He’s got lots of space, but I didn’t think his room was very comfortable.
And what about the kitchen?
We didn’t stay in there long, because it wasn’t very warm. Sophie’s mum says they’re going to change it. She wants a more modern kitchen.
What’s the living room like?
I thought the chairs were really nice to sit in, and the carpet’s soft. In their old house, the living room was dark, but this one isn’t.
That’s good.
And just before I left, I saw the bathroom. I’ve never seen one like that before. The colours are so strange.
It sounds like you saw the whole house!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
